title: viola beraudii subsp. adriatica
intro: Viola beraudii subsp. adriatica, commonly known as the Adriatic pansy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family, characterized by its delicate, fragrant flowers. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola beraudii subsp. adriatica include calming and soothing effects, which can help to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
